data.long_meaning: The name Dafina is derived from the Hebrew word ‘daf’, meaning ‘clear’ or ‘bright’. In the Bible, the name is associated with the radiant light of God, representing wisdom, clarity, and divine guidance. In Christian tradition, Dafina is believed to symbolize the inner light of faith and the purity of the soul. The name Dafina carries the meaning “Bright, clear, shining” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Dafina usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, clear, shining and live with faith, good character and purpose.
